'''psyokid (VSC)Fast and the Furious''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[psyokid]]
* '''Published:''' 21 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Let Them Make The First Move
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 FirstMove psyokid DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

LightSaber combat with racig thats gone 9-0 over the last 4 tournys.

== Strategy ==

Basic Strategy:  Use the race to cause damage fast even if they play the shield you still retrieve force.  If they are also playing racing start the Blaster Rack(v) to get your sabers out fast.  Always set up Maul on Naboo in the Generator Core with his saber for drains of 4... always lose the force to drain them for 4.  Start the box against everything cept for a deck with racing.  Against combat mainly win the race and combat.  You might lose some but then try to use your backup characters to kill off Qui-Gon.  Dont wry about other jedis since they only do 2 damage where Qui does 4.  Against certian decks Use counter assault to deal some damage.  If they leave a opening use maul to beatdown if hes not on talbe.  Use vader like in Hunt Down.  Drain at their sites and battle with destiny adders and use dueling cards.  Any questions e-mail at kydo68@hotmail.com thanks.
